svg.title: Quick sort partitioning trace
svg.desc: Step by step partitioning of array using last element as pivot showing left and right pointers moving
svg.text: Quick Sort — Partition step (pivot = 70, last element)
Partition rule: elements ≤ pivot go left, elements > pivot go right. Pivot ends at correct sorted position.
Recurse on left subarray [10,30,40,50] and right [80,90]. Best/avg O(n log n), worst O(n²) if already sorted.
